types.passive: Dual-wield axes that deal chop damage. Has a +25% physical damage bonus to wood.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing 45% / 45% / 55% physical damage.

skills.name: Frenzy
skills.description: Dash forward and strike the first enemy dealing 100% physical damage. Enter a state of frenzy that increases your movement speed by 25% and increases attack speed by 50% for 1.5s on a successful hit.

skills.name: X-Strike
skills.description: Throw two axes in the shape of an X. Each hit deals 80% physical damage and slows the enemy for 1.5s. Hitting the enemy where both axes intersect inflicts a 1s incapacitate.

types.passive: A fierce weapon that deals physical damage.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description:
Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing 40% / 40% / 50% physical damage. The third attack inflicts Puncture stacking up to 3 times.
Trigger a rupture dealing 75% damage to the target and 50% damage to nearby enemies upon reaching maximum stacks.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.description: Vault towards the cursor and cleave enemies dealing 90% physical damage and inflicting Puncture. May be recast once after hitting an enemy.

skills.name: Skewering Leap
skills.description:
Leap to target location, dealing 100% physical damage, inflicting Puncture and a 1.2s incapacitate.
You bounce off enemies toward your aim direction. Missing an enemy will cause you to stick to the ground for a short duration. (0.45s)

variants.name: Sanguine Claws
variants.bonus: Has a +25% physical damage bonus to vegetation and thickets.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Fire a projectile that deals 100% physical damage on hit. Consumes Marked dealing 25% bonus damage and increasing your attack speed by 7% for 10s, this effect stacks up to 3 times.

skills.name: Rain of Bolts
skills.description: Fire a salvo of 5 bolts into the air that rains down on your enemies dealing 40% physical damage each in an area, inflicts Marked and inflicts a 1.5s fading snare.

skills.name: Snapshot
skills.description: Fire a quick bolt that deals 75% physical damage, interrupts attacks, inflicts Marked and inflicts a 1.5s fading snare. The bolt splits into two upon hit.

types.passive: A throwing weapon that deals physical damage.

skills.name: Throw Dagger
skills.description:
Throw up to 4 daggers, each dealing 40% physical damage. Hitting an enemy or a solid object causes the dagger to stick to the ground.
Gain one dagger stack every 1.1s.

skills.name: Rain of Daggers
skills.description: Leap into the air and throw 4 daggers in front of you, each dagger dealing 40% physical damage and inflicting a 2s fading snare. Daggers remain on the ground for 8s.

skills.name: Release Daggers
skills.description: Inflict a 1.5s fading snare and release all nearby daggers that are stuck in the ground. Released daggers return to you, piercing enemies and dealing 40% physical damage. Each dagger that returns grant one dagger stack and reduces the cooldown of Rain of Daggers by 0.2s.

types.passive: A great heavy sword that deals physical damage. Has a greater effect on wood. +25% Physical Damage to Wood

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a Combo of melee attacks dealing 70% / 70% / 80% physical damage.

skills.name: Great Cleaver
skills.description: Charge forward and swing your greatsword upward dealing 125% physical damage in an area and launching enemies into the air for 0.65s.

skills.name: Death from Above
skills.description:
Leap into the air and descend upon your enemy dealing 125% physical damage in an area.
Note: Turns immaterial during leap

skills.name: Primary
skills.description:
Hold to charge a projectile that deals 60% - 120% physical damage on hit and grants Focus. Focus stacks up to 3 times and increases the effectiveness of your other Longbow skills.

Fully charged shots pierces up to 2 enemies, subsequent hits deal 50% damage of the previous hit.

skills.name: Multishot
skills.description: Fire 5 piercing arrows in a cone dealing 100% physical damage and knocking enemies back. Consumes Focus launching one additional arrow per stack, each dealing 20% bonus damage.

skills.name: Guided Arrow
skills.description: Fire an arrow dealing 120% physical damage and inflicting a 2s fading snare. The arrow turns to hit the same target again after impact dealing 50% damage. Consumes Focus increasing the number of times the arrow turns by one per stack.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a Combo of melee attacks dealing 50% / 50% / 60% physical damage.

skills.name: Crushing Blow
skills.description: Vault towards the cursor and slam your mace into the ground dealing 150% physical damage and inflicting a 2s fading snare.

skills.name: Smack
skills.description: Smack enemies in front of you dealing 70% physical damage, knocking them back and incapacitating them for 1s.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Fire a salvo of projectiles dealing 65% / 50% / 50% physical damage.

skills.name: Fan The Hammer
skills.description: Fire 10 bullets in a cone over 1.3s, each bullet deals 25% physical damage and knocks the target back. You can move while channeling at 35% movement speed.

skills.name: Explosive Bullet
skills.description: Perform a dodge roll followed by firing an explosive bullet dealing 25% physical damage. The bullet explodes after 3s dealing 115% physical damage in an area and knocking nearby enemies back.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a Combo of melee attacks dealing 50% / 50% / 55% physical damage.

skills.name: Tendon Swing
skills.description: Swing your reaper dealing 130% physical damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back and inflicting a 2s fading snare.

skills.name: Howling Reaper
skills.description:
Throw a howling reaper that spins in place dealing 180% physical damage over 2.2 s. The initial hit deals 50% physical damage and slows enemies for 1.5 s.
Note: 9 hits total

variants.name: The General's Soul Reaper
variants.bonus:
+25% Damage to Undead
+6 Spell Power
+5 Spell Critical Chance

types.passive: Dual-wield blades that deal slash damage. Has a +25% physical damage bonus to vegetation and thickets.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing 28% / 28% / 35% physical damage.

skills.name: Elusive Strike
skills.description: Dash back and forth slashing at your enemies dealing 70% physical damage and inflicting a 1.5s fading snare on each hit.

skills.name: Camouflage
skills.description: Enter a state of invisibility, increasing movement speed by 25% for 2.5s. Your next primary attack deals 80% physical damage and incapacitates the enemy for 2s. Using any skill breaks camouflage.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a Combo of melee attacks dealing 40% / 40% / 50% physical damage.

skills.name: A Thousand Spears
skills.description:
Perform a multi-stab attack, dealing 140% physical damage and interrupting enemy actions over 1.15s.
(8 stabs total)

Recast during the effect to perform a thrust attack dealing 50% physical damage and knocking enemies back.

skills.name: Harpoon
skills.description: Throw a spear that deals 110% physical damage, pulls the enemy towards you and inflict a 1.5s fading snare.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing 35% / 35% / 40% physical damage.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.description:
Spin around and slice nearby enemies dealing 175% physical damage over 1.1s.
Notes: movement speed is increased during the spin.

skills.name: Shockwave
skills.description:
Send forth a shockwave dealing 100% physical damage and launching the enemy hit into the air for 1.6s.
Recast the ability to teleport to the target striking it three times, each strike dealing 20% physical damage.

types.passive:
A weapon with a piercing attack that deals
additional physical damage in an area at mid-range.

skills.name: Primary
skills.description: Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing 35% / 35% / 40% physical damage to enemeis in a line. Deals 65% / 65% / 70% physical damage in a small radius at the tip of the whip.

skills.name: Aerial Whip Twirl
skills.description: Leap towards the cursor and swing your whip around you dealing 100% physical damage, knocking enemies back and inflicting a 1.5 s fading snare.

skills.name: Entangling Whip
skills.description: Strike in a line dealing 100% physical damage and inflicting a 2s entangle.
